Jordan / Kimberly —

Below is the technical synthesis from our side (concise):

Executive root cause summary:
- Primary cause: transient KV-cache eviction storm triggered by a control-plane metadata update that ran concurrently with a batch of long sequence requests. Evictions caused increased repeated key fetches and degraded throughput on the tokenization microservice.
- Secondary contributor: degraded RPC retry backoff configuration on a dependent service (indexer) amplified load during recoveries.

Timeline (UTC):
- 2026-11-06T02:10 — routine metadata rollout began (control-plane).
- 2026-11-06T02:15 — first elevated tokenization latencies observed; autoscaling delayed due to cache churn.
- 2026-11-06T02:25 — traffic spikes from replayed long-seq inference requests; error budget burned for short period.
- 2026-11-06T02:47 — mitigation: hotfix applied (cache eviction throttle + tuned retry backoff) and rolling config reverted for control-plane rollout.
- 2026-11-06T03:05 — metrics returned to baseline.

Immediate mitigations completed on Nov 6:
- Reverted metadata rollout to previous stable version.
- Applied a short-term throttle on KV-cache eviction frequency.
- Tuned retry backoffs for indexer RPCs to smooth retries.

Planned corrective actions (deliverables attached in final pack):
1) Permanent guard: control-plane rollout pre-check to block concurrent heavy-cache operations (owner: Marissa Cole, ETA: 2026-11-30).
2) Autoscale improvement: proactive cache-aware autoscaling policy to ensure faster capacity during churn (owner: Dylan Brooks, ETA: 2026-12-14).
3) Retry strategy overhaul for dependent RPCs with staged rollout and canary checks (owner: Marissa Cole, ETA: 2026-12-07).
4) Post-deployment verification checklist and automated smoke tests for tokenization path (owner: Dylan Brooks, ETA: 2026-11-20).

Attachments (zipped in the evidence bundle): timeline.csv (detailed event log), mitigation-plan-v1.pdf (action descriptions + owners + dates), aurora_evidence_bundle.zip (sanitized logs & traces for your audit team).

If you want a translation of the technical timeline into operations/SLR terms for your procurement team, we can produce that as a one-page addendum.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole

- Impact: elevated latencies, increased retries, temporary authorization drop for impacted customers.
